title: Build it from the chat when the audit flagged the time column
request: The owner said build it, ok and yes on Home; nothing was built, and messages sent while it answered were refused with 409.
spec: The leakage audit flagged signup_date (it alone separated the classes) and the same proposal chose it as the time column; the solution refuses a time column that is also forbidden.
plan: Resolve the contradiction where the chat builds: the plan the chat gave orders the split by the column, so it stays the time column, leaves the forbidden list, and its flag is kept in the notes

decisions.decision: The time column stays; it leaves the forbidden list with its flag written in the notes.
decisions.why: The chat had told the person the split follows this column and they agreed; a time column is never a feature, so the leak the flag fears cannot reach the model.

change: draft/api.py (the build's solution from the proposal), tests/test_draft_flow.py.

findings.defect: Build it was refused on every yes, with an instruction to untick a box the chat does not show.
findings.scenario: A synthetic table where signup_date separated the classes; the chat planned a time split on it; the person said build it, ok, yes.
findings.cause: The proposal put signup_date both first among the time candidates and on the forbidden list; the solution's check refuses that pair.
findings.fix: The chat's build drops the time column from the forbidden list and notes why it was flagged.

findings.scenario: The person sent ok and yes again while a model turn was still answering.
findings.cause: One turn at a time per draft: a second message waits for the first. It looked like a failure because the build never came.
findings.fix: None needed beyond B1: the page already says to send again in a moment.

measurements.name: The chat's build with a flagged time column
measurements.gate: a project is built with the column as its time column, not forbidden, the flag in the notes
measurements.result: built: time column set, not forbidden, the note says why
limits: the wizard's sheet still shows both ticks for the person to resolve

outcome: Build it works when the audit's time column is also flagged; the flag is kept for the person to check.
lessons: An agent must not ask the person to resolve a contradiction it created in a place the person cannot see.
risks: A time column recorded after the outcome would still order the split; the note asks the person to check it.
